title: He Opened Every Window in January

lines.vo: This man opened every window in the office... in the middle of January.
Dave said, "Close it, Kevin. We're not penguins."
Kevin just said, "Trust me. You'll thank me at three."
By eleven, Dave had shut every single window.
At three o'clock, Dave stood up to give the biggest pitch of his career...
Here's why. Every breath you let out is full of carbon dioxide.
In a closed room full of people, it can pass fourteen hundred parts per million in a few hours.
At that level, a Harvard study found people's thinking scores dropped by about half.
It's like zipping your head inside a sleeping bag... and then trying to do math.
So the next morning, Dave walked straight past Kevin... and opened every window himself.
